campaigns.convergence: Failed the preselected 10% stability target. At 3 Gyr, halving/doubling softening changes local strength by +19%/−40%; halving timestep by −23%; tightening force accuracy by −16%; quadrupling particles by −31%. The second seed changes it by +18%. At 50 pc, halving timestep changes strength by −35%; at the common 0.1 Myr timestep, 25 versus 50 pc changes it by +45%. All ten runs are complete.
campaigns.verdict: All ten runs reached 3 Gyr. Collective gravity produces a strong bar followed by weakening and vertical thickening; the entirely fixed round-field control stays nearly round. All runs pass their appropriate conservation checks. Final live-run amplitudes overlap the preselected observed distribution, but large numerical sensitivity prevents quantitative convergence or observational validation. This is a benchmarked demonstration, not a CDM-versus-SIDM test.
